company.shortDescription: Garment IO provides plug and play garment manufacturing management solution.
company.description: Garment IO is a plug and play Garment Manufacturing Management Solution combining software and hardware to give garment factory managers and owners a complete overview on production processes, worker performance and production cost calculation. All down to the transaction detail, real-time and accessible online.

productsAndServices.description: A module that tracks machine downtime, analyzes causes, and manages technician and maintenance staff performance.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $450,000, or 75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,263,554 to $3,821,284, a 3.02x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
